treatmentJourney.title: Consultation & Diagnosis
treatmentJourney.description: Your visit begins with a thorough consultation, including digital X-rays and Cone Beam CT imaging, to accurately diagnose the affected tooth and plan your personalized root canal treatment.

treatmentJourney.title: Anesthesia & Isolation
treatmentJourney.description: We ensure your comfort with local anesthesia, and then isolate the tooth with a rubber dam to maintain a sterile environment throughout the procedure.

treatmentJourney.title: Cleaning & Disinfection
treatmentJourney.description: Using surgical microscopes and advanced GentleWave UltraCleaning technology, we meticulously clean and disinfect each root canal, removing infected pulp and bacteria.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Sealing
treatmentJourney.description: Once thoroughly cleaned, the canals are precisely sealed with a biocompatible material to prevent re-infection and protect the integrity of the tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Temporary Restoration
treatmentJourney.description: A temporary restoration is placed on the treated tooth, and you will be referred back to your general dentist for the placement of a permanent crown or filling.

treatmentJourney.title: Follow-Up & Healing
treatmentJourney.description: We schedule follow-up imaging to confirm complete healing of the tooth and surrounding tissues, ensuring the long-term success of your root canal therapy.

benefits.title: Pain Relief
benefits.description: Eliminate severe tooth pain and discomfort caused by infection or injury.

benefits.title: Save Natural Tooth
benefits.description: Preserve your natural tooth, avoiding extraction and maintaining your natural bite.

benefits.title: Prevent Infection Spread
benefits.description: Remove infected pulp to prevent the spread of bacteria to other teeth or into the bloodstream.

benefits.title: Improved Oral Health
benefits.description: Address the source of infection to improve overall oral hygiene and health.

benefits.title: Long-Term Solution
benefits.description: With proper care, a root canal treated tooth can last a lifetime.

benefits.title: Maintain Aesthetics
benefits.description: Keep your natural smile and facial structure intact without the need for prosthetic replacements.

implantOptions.title: Root Canal Treatment
implantOptions.description: Removes infected pulp, eliminates pain, and preserves your natural tooth with a comfortable, effective procedure.

implantOptions.title: Endodontic Retreatment
implantOptions.description: Specialized retreatment for failing or re-infected root canals that may not have healed correctly, offering a second chance to save the tooth.

implantOptions.title: Emergency Root Canal Care
implantOptions.description: Provides prompt relief for severe tooth pain, infection, abscesses, and dental trauma requiring immediate treatment.

implantOptions.title: Apicoectomy (Root-End Surgery)
implantOptions.description: A minor surgical procedure that removes infection at the root tip when conventional root canal treatment isn't enough.

implantOptions.title: Cracked Tooth Treatment
implantOptions.description: Diagnoses and treats cracked or fractured teeth to relieve discomfort and improve the chances of saving the tooth.

implantOptions.title: Dental Crown Restoration
implantOptions.description: Protects and strengthens a tooth after root canal therapy with a custom-made crown for long-lasting durability.

faqItems.question: Do root canals really hurt anymore?
faqItems.answer: Modern root canal therapy at Gentle Endodontics uses advanced techniques and anesthesia to ensure a comfortable and pain-free experience, dispelling old myths about the procedure.

faqItems.question: How long does a root canal take?
faqItems.answer: Many root canal procedures at Gentle Endodontics are completed in a single visit when feasible, thanks to advanced technology and efficient techniques.

faqItems.question: How much does a root canal cost?
faqItems.answer: The cost of a root canal varies depending on the tooth and complexity. Gentle Endodontics provides financial policies and works with insurance to make treatment accessible, and offers CareCredit.

faqItems.question: What happens if I don't get the root canal?
faqItems.answer: Without a root canal, the infection will worsen, potentially leading to increased pain, abscess formation, bone loss, and ultimately, the loss of the tooth.

faqItems.question: Will I need a crown after my root canal?
faqItems.answer: After your root canal, Gentle Endodontics performs a temporary restoration and refers you back to your general dentist for a permanent crown to protect the tooth.

faqItems.question: Can a root canal save my cracked tooth?
faqItems.answer: Root canal therapy can often save cracked teeth by removing infected pulp and sealing the tooth, preventing further damage and preserving the tooth's structure.

doctor.name: Dr. Nivine Y. El-Refai
doctor.bio: With over 20 years of experience in root canal therapies, Dr. Nivine El-Refai is a Diplomate of the American Board of Endodontics, having achieved this distinction in December 2014 from Case Western Reserve University School of Dentistry. She is dedicated to providing outstanding endodontic care in a gentle, calming, and relaxing atmosphere, utilizing the most advanced evidence-based technologies. Dr. El-Refai prioritizes patient safety and successful treatment outcomes, specializing in severe endodontic issues and making every effort to see emergency patients on the same day.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: I was so nervous about my root canal, but Dr. El-Refai and her team at Gentle Endodontics were amazing. The warm blanket and classical music really helped me relax. The whole process was far more comfortable than I ever imagined!

reviews.name: James W.
reviews.text: Dr. El-Refai truly lives up to the 'Gentle' in their name. My endodontic retreatment was handled with such care and precision, and the GentleWave technology made a noticeable difference. My pain is gone, and I'm so grateful.

reviews.name: Emily R.
reviews.text: After experiencing severe tooth pain, Gentle Endodontics saw me the same day. Dr. El-Refai quickly diagnosed my issue using their advanced CBCT scanner and performed a root canal that relieved my pain almost instantly. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Michael T.
reviews.text: The entire team at Gentle Endodontics is professional and kind. They clearly explained the apicoectomy procedure and what to expect with the costs and insurance. It's refreshing to find a dental office that cares so much.

reviews.name: Jessica L.
reviews.text: I was so worried my cracked tooth couldn't be saved, but Dr. El-Refai's expertise and diagnostic tools identified the problem accurately. Thanks to her skillful root canal, my tooth is saved, and I can chew comfortably again.

reviews.name: David K.
reviews.text: Gentle Endodontics provides exceptional care. Dr. El-Refai's experience and advanced technology like the GentleWave made my root canal procedure efficient and thorough. I felt well-informed and comfortable throughout my visit.
